about: Jose's command centre settings, at Jose's word (4 November 2026), as his dashboard agent asked: his lanes as workstreams (his own words, people/jose/card.md), his agents' jobs, and chat in the page (llm, copied from Dinis's config). Kept by conductor@web-summit.jose and dashboard@web-summit.jose (people/jose/ only); admin/build/commandcentre.mjs reads this and takes the rest from its defaults. Decisions come from the stand-up agenda by themselves. No key or secret ever goes in this file: the OpenRouter key, if Jose adds one, stays in his browser only.

workstreams.name: Agent security conversations
workstreams.goal: Technical conversations on agent security with the companies Jose owns (Descope, Polygraf AI, Emergence, Mastra).

workstreams.name: The live demos: attacked, then governed
workstreams.goal: Hack the Agent and ReachCheck on the stand: show an agent being attacked, then governed.

workstreams.name: Voice and language agents
workstreams.goal: A lane for companies building voice or multilingual agents (Jose's card).

workstreams.name: Automation and the machine
workstreams.goal: The broadcasts, the feedback form, the page views, the watcher and the reviewer: carried by Jose's agents.

conductor.job: conducts Jose's agents and keeps people/jose/ with Jose: onboarding, agents.json, ack.json, stand-up items, the mentor's notes, and a numbered PDF brief to Jose
conductor.schedule: cron 20 7,12,17 * * * (UTC), the wake; and cron 7 * * * * (UTC), the hourly page-view run (WS-37), which only counts from 6 November 2026, 00:07 UTC, until the conductor has an SG/Send token of its own (Dinis's rule); both scheduled tasks fire into its own session, set at Jose's word on 3 and 4 November 2026

dashboard.job: keeps Jose's dashboard, people/jose/dashboard.md, the page Jose reads first
dashboard.schedule: cron 30 7,12,17 * * * (UTC), a scheduled task firing into its own session ('dashboard@web-summit.jose wake'), recorded at Jose's word on 3 November 2026

dev.job: a builder developer for automations and integrations (n8n, WhatsApp, the site)
dev.schedule: cron 30 9,15 * * * (UTC), a scheduled task firing into its own session ('dev@web-summit.jose wake'), set at Jose's word on 3 November 2026

designer.job: designs for Jose: the command centre directions and the WS-39 broadcast looks (people/jose/design/)
designer.schedule: on demand (no schedule), at Jose's word

vault.job: creates and manages Jose's SGit vaults (WS-120, /vault-agent/)
vault.schedule: cron 40 11,17 * * * (UTC), a scheduled task firing into its own session since 5 November 2026 (its commit 47b7021)

automation.job: started 4 November 2026 at Jose's word (first commit 998e857, 23:22): the n8n flows as tested code, WS-39 route 3 and the n8n side of WS-74
automation.schedule: cron 10 10,16 * * * (UTC), a scheduled task firing into its own session since 4 November 2026 (its commit 765de20)

helper.job: started 4 November 2026 at Jose's word (first commit 11884fc, 23:22): helps anyone stuck on setup (WS-35), drafts their next step for Jose to send, writes down what went wrong
helper.schedule: cron 50 8,14 * * * (UTC), a scheduled task firing into its own session since 5 November 2026 (its commit c3342b2)

watcher.schedule: cron 15 7,12,17,22 * * * (UTC), a scheduled task firing into its own session since 4 November 2026, 23:10 UTC (its commit f1e9241); the 22:15 run added at Jose's word on 5 November 2026

reviewer.job: Jose's code reviewer, a sub-agent in each of Jose's agents' sessions that reviews every diff before it is pushed and may hold Jose's agents only (people/jose/reviewer/ROLE.md)

accountant.job: started at Jose's word (4 November 2026): a sub-agent of the conductor's 07:20 wake, not a chat
accountant.schedule: in the conductor's 07:20 wake, once a day
